Step 1. Log into your blog Step 2. Click Appearance-> Widgets Step 3. Drag RSS over to your sidebar. Step 4. Paste http://newsrss.bbc.co.uk/rss/cbbc_news/homepage/rss.xml in where it asks for RSS feed URL Step 5. Give the widget a title. *optional

Note: PrimaryBlogger users can just drag the CBBC Widget onto their sidebar.
